messages:
incident-bot: Paging: High failed authentication rate detected across /v1/auth and /v1/generate. Threshold breach: 500 failed auths/min. Detector: abuse-detector-cred-spray-34. Affected region: global, spike concentrated in APAC.

oncall-nick: Ack. I'm on-call and investigating. Pulling logs + recent deploys.

security-maria: I'm correlating WAF hits now. Early signal: same UA strings + simple JSON payloads, looks like credential-spray. Will check IP clustering.

infra-jay: Can we temporarily tighten per-key rate limits? Current per-key minute = 120. Proposal: reduce to 30 rpm and add burst cap.

oncall-nick: Good call. Applying conservative per-key throttle to reduce blast radius. Pushing config change.

incident-bot: Action taken: rate_limit.update (policy_id: throttle-temp-2026-03-15) applied by oncall-nick at 1812349030. New per_key_minute=30, burst=60.

product-alyssa: Any customer-facing 429s expected? Which keys will be impacted?

oncall-nick: Most affected are low-entropy API keys and many anonymous tokens. We'll see elevated 429s for a subset; not a full outage. Support, please standby for customer contacts.

support-lee: Ready. If we get customer reports I'll open/upsert tickets and share diagnostics. Prep standard support note.

security-maria: WAF side: top offending IPs grouped into two /24s. Suggest temporary CIDR blocks + UA pattern block. UA pattern: "Mozilla/5.0 (Headless)" variants and blank referers.

infra-jay: I can push WAF CIDR blocks. Command I will run:
```
ctl waf block add 52.14.120.0/24 --rule 112 --reason "credential-spray spike"
ctl waf block add 198.51.100.0/24 --rule 112 --reason "credential-spray spike"
```

incident-bot: WAF blocks queued. Waiting for infra-jay execution.

infra-jay: Executed blocks. Adding temporary expiration 2h. Monitoring metrics.

oncall-nick: Early telemetry: failed auth rate down ~48%, token abuse reduced, overall 429s increased for some legitimate flows behind shared proxies.

product-alyssa: We should be cautious — customers behind carrier NATs could see collateral 429s. Prepare rollback path and customer whitelist flow.

security-maria: Enabling CAPTCHA on /auth/attempts for flagged sessions to further reduce automated attempts. Will route suspicious sessions to challenge.

incident-bot: Action: captcha.enable route=/auth/attempts scope=flagged_ips by security-maria at 1812349088.

support-lee: Customer "customer_b" reported elevated 429s on their internal ingestion job. Opening ticket INC-4521. Asking for source IPs.

infra-jay: Got IPs from support: 203.0.113.44/32 and 203.0.113.45/32 belong to customer_b. Adding allowlist entries now.

incident-bot: Allowlist update: waf.allow add 203.0.113.44/32, 203.0.113.45/32 (manual by infra-jay) at 1812349115.

oncall-nick: Verified customer_b traffic flows restored after allowlist. Leaving runbook notes for handoff:
- Rate limiter: per-key_minute set to 30 (throttle-temp-2026-03-15) at 1812349030
- WAF CIDR blocks: 52.14.120.0/24, 198.51.100.0/24 (2h expiry)
- CAPTCHA enabled on /auth/attempts for flagged IPs
- Customer_b allowlist: 203.0.113.44/32, 203.0.113.45/32

product-alyssa: Assigning post-incident action owners: security-maria for detection tuning, infra-jay for rate-limiter runbook improvements, oncall-nick to finalize timeline. Please include impact metrics (requests blocked, false positive count, customer tickets).

oncall-nick: Drafting incident notes and timeline. ETA ~30m. Will include Prometheus graphs and WAF logs.

sre-simone: Taking over next shift. I'll watch for reoccurrence and check for rotated IPs or new UA variants. Ping me if we need rollback.

support-lee: Customer_b confirmed their ingestion resumed. Keeping ticket open until postmortem and permanent whitelist procedure in place.

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Page closed at 1812349175. :white_check_mark:
